changes: Adds browsing-session cancellation so stale image/video BODY work is interrupted when switching groups, views, filters, or replacing the current page.
Keeps up to two short-lived NNTP header sessions warm for interactive page loads and retires them after about ten seconds idle.
Prefetches the next older header page several viewport-heights ahead while scrolling downward so continuous browsing can append with less visible waiting.
Makes thumbnail demand scroll-direction and velocity aware so v3.6.6 adaptive preview concurrency stays fed without fixed-distance overfetch.
Returns an initial All Posts package view sooner, then finishes deep multipart reconstruction in a bounded background worker and refreshes the page in place.
Bounds long-scroll thumbnail watchdog work and releases far-offscreen decoded thumbnails while retaining cached thumbnail URLs for quick return scrolling.
Preserves v3.6.6 adaptive preview scaling, v3.6.5 taskbar identity, and all v3.6.4 package-browser behavior.
regression_guards: v3.6.6 Adaptive Preview Connection Scaling remains preserved.
v3.6.5 Windows Taskbar Identity Reliability remains preserved.
v3.6.4 Newsgroup Package Browser & Binary Reconstruction remains preserved.
v3.6.3 Automation Sidebar Startup & Cache Reliability remains preserved.
v3.6.2 Tray Upgrade Lock Reliability and v3.6.1 Installer Upgrade Reliability remain preserved.
v3.6.0 UI/UX Overhaul and v3.5.52 Authoritative Service Runtime Handoff remain preserved.
Private SAB downloads, Smart Import, Automation, Discover/TMDB, provider state, and Metadata Server v0.3.3 compatibility remain preserved.
name: Browsing Pipeline & Long-Scroll Performance
